[Correct link syntax](https://www.example.com/)

For (example)[^1] footnotes are fine.

Escaped \(not a link)[https://www.example.com/] is fine.

Followed by a parenthesis (text)[label](https://www.example.com/) is fine.

`(in code)[https://www.example.com/]` is fine.

```text
(in a code block)[https://www.example.com/]
```

<div>
(in HTML)[https://www.example.com/]
</div>

[^1]: The footnote.
